steps.name: run campaigns, red controls, and findings reports
steps.shell:
set -euo pipefail
output=edenfs-exploratory-nightly
mkdir -p "$output/campaigns"
runtime_dir="/run/user/$(id -u)"
test -S "$runtime_dir/bus" || { echo "no user DBus session bus at $runtime_dir/bus"; exit 1; }
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime_dir"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$runtime_dir/bus"
sl help agent > /dev/null
sl help log > /dev/null
sl help goto > /dev/null
job_commit=$(sl --reason 'Remember the job checkout that holds the harness - sl help log' log -r . -T '{node}')
sl goto remote/master --reason 'Build the nightly daemon from master - sl help goto'
EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_COMMIT=$(sl --reason 'Capture nightly daemon source - sl help log' log -r . -T '{node}')
EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_TIMESTAMP=$(sl --reason 'Capture nightly daemon source time - sl help log' log -r "$EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_COMMIT" -T '{date|hgdate}' | awk '{print $1}')
export EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_COMMIT EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_TIMESTAMP
if grep -q fatal_eden_bug fbcode/eden/fs/service/EdenMain.cpp; then fatal_eden_bug=true; else fatal_eden_bug=false; fi
build_output=$(mktemp)
buck2 build @fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//eden/fs/service:edenfs fbcode//eden/fs/cli_rs/edenfsctl:edenfsctl fbcode//eden/fs/cli:edenfsctl fbcode//eden/scm:hg --show-full-output > "$build_output"
built() { awk -v target="$1" '$1 == target {print $2}' "$build_output"; }
EDENFS_SERVER_PATH=$(built fbcode//eden/fs/service:edenfs)
EDENFSCTL_RUST_PATH=$(built fbcode//eden/fs/cli_rs/edenfsctl:edenfsctl)
EDENFSCTL_REAL_PATH=$(built fbcode//eden/fs/cli:edenfsctl)
EDEN_HG_BINARY=$(built fbcode//eden/scm:hg)
HG_REAL_BIN="$EDEN_HG_BINARY"
EDENFS_PRIVHELPER_PATH=/usr/local/libexec/eden/edenfs_privhelper
for binary in "$EDENFS_SERVER_PATH" "$EDENFSCTL_RUST_PATH" "$EDENFSCTL_REAL_PATH" "$EDEN_HG_BINARY" "$EDENFS_PRIVHELPER_PATH"; do test -x "$binary"; done
export EDENFS_SERVER_PATH EDENFSCTL_RUST_PATH EDENFSCTL_REAL_PATH EDEN_HG_BINARY HG_REAL_BIN EDENFS_PRIVHELPER_PATH
export EDENFS_DAEMON_FATAL_EDEN_BUG="$fatal_eden_bug"
sl goto "$job_commit" --reason 'Run the harness at the job checkout - sl help goto'
explore="buck2 run -c fbcc.rust=False @fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//eden/integration/correctness/exploratory:explore --"
red_control_spec=fbcode/eden/integration/correctness/exploratory/decks/red-control.json
red_controls=$($explore red-controls --target edenfs)
rotating_start=$(( 100000 + ($(date -u +%s) / 86400 % 10000) * 64 ))
run_campaign() {
  name=$1
  shift
  dir="$output/campaigns/$name"
  set +e
  $explore campaign --target edenfs --daemon public-master --files 256 --keep rejects --artifacts "$dir/artifacts" --report "$dir/report.json" "$@"
  status=$?
  set -e
  test -f "$dir/report.json"
  echo "$name campaign exit: $status"
  campaign_id=$(python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("campaign_id") or "")' "$dir/report.json")
  for red_control in ${red_controls:-}; do
    $explore run --target edenfs --spec "$red_control_spec" --red-control "$red_control" --campaign-id "$campaign_id" --artifacts "$dir/red-controls/$red_control" || true
  done
  $explore findings --target edenfs --report "$dir/report.json" --artifacts "$dir/artifacts" --red-controls "$dir"/red-controls/* || echo "$name" >> "$output/failed-gates"
}
run_campaign fixed --seed-start 0 --seeds 40
run_campaign rotating --seed-start "$rotating_start" --seeds 40
run_campaign differential --seed-start "$rotating_start" --seeds 10 --differential
$explore run --target edenfs --spec "$red_control_spec" --artifacts "$output/vehicle" || echo vehicle >> "$output/failed-gates"

steps.name: emit scalar campaign rows
steps.shell:
set -euo pipefail
explore="buck2 run -c fbcc.rust=False @fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//eden/integration/correctness/exploratory:explore --"
for name in fixed rotating differential; do
  dir="edenfs-exploratory-nightly/campaigns/$name"
  $explore emit --report "$dir/report.json" --findings "$dir/findings/findings.json" > "$dir/telemetry.jsonl"
done
if [ -s edenfs-exploratory-nightly/failed-gates ]; then echo "health or red-control gates failed: $(cat edenfs-exploratory-nightly/failed-gates)"; exit 1; fi

description: Nightly exploratory campaigns. Runs as a Sandcastle node in the eden/eden conveyor, beside "eden smoke tests"; the daemon is the release package's edenfs, passed through EDENFS_SERVER_PATH, the one variable the campaign hashes as the daemon identity. Every campaign seed uses the default runner deadline (600 s: operation 120 s, cleanup 30 s).
